scenes.headline: Every great product starts with clarity.
scenes.body: Capture the users, the constraints and what success should look like.
scenes.receipt: Product brief is created by the user, not by a hosted model.

scenes.headline: A strong beginning is engineered.
scenes.body: Oryveta's local Python engine can scaffold runnable starter repositories with baseline tests.
scenes.receipt: Local implementation available; hosted execution is not live.

scenes.headline: Proof is part of the product.
scenes.body: Every future cloud job must attach tests, reviewable changes and clear limitations.
scenes.receipt: Evidence gate and local test harness exist; deployment requires review.

scenes.headline: See what you are changing.
scenes.body: Inspect a repository snapshot before proposing any code changes.
scenes.receipt: The local engine supports public GitHub and ZIP snapshots.

scenes.headline: Better code needs context.
scenes.body: Investigate findings and build a read-only patch proposal with known trade-offs.
scenes.receipt: Local read-only patch previews exist; no auto-merge.

scenes.headline: Don't ship without evidence.
scenes.body: Independent tests and human review guard the path to an approved PR.
scenes.receipt: Cloud sandbox, real PR automation and verifier are future features.

scenes.headline: Capture the complete outcome.
scenes.body: A useful experiment records failures, runtime costs and acceptance criteria as well as wins.
scenes.receipt: Offline evidence records exist, not autonomous learning.

scenes.headline: Compare on equal footing.
scenes.body: Run baseline and candidate over matched tasks; reject safety failures, regressions and cost overruns.
scenes.receipt: Implemented in the Python evidence gate.

scenes.headline: Only reviewed improvements ship.
scenes.body: A favorable result creates a recommendation for human review, never an automatic production change.
scenes.receipt: Fail-closed human approval is enforced by current evaluation gate.
